dedupe_keys.name: ciriabest ciria benefits estimation tool formerly b st for blue green infrastructure

description: ciriabest is CIRIA's online, map-based tool for estimating the monetary value of the multiple benefits of blue-green infrastructure, so that business cases can be made without a full-scale economic study. It covers benefits of sustainable drainage, natural flood management and other blue-green measures compared with a do nothing baseline, guiding users through a structured estimation that records confidence in the data, lets several projects in an area be compared, can be applied retrospectively to existing schemes, and produces PDF outputs for funding bids; the 2019 spreadsheet version used evidence up to 2018 and values in 2017 prices. It was developed by CIRIA, first released as the BeST spreadsheet in 2015, updated as B£ST in 2019 and relaunched as the online ciriabest in April 2023. Access is through paid annual licences of 600 pounds plus VAT for an individual or 2,500 pounds plus VAT for up to ten users, with a discount for CIRIA and susdrain members, under CIRIA terms and conditions. Caveats: values rest on published evidence transferred to the site, so local appraisal may still be needed. It supports cost-benefit appraisal of green-blue infrastructure for flood risk and climate adaptation investment; a related record is the SuDS Manual.
